verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://help.getzep.com/llms.txt, which serves an agent-oriented doc index. A versioned v3/llms.txt also exists, and the v4 llms.txt points agents to the raw OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Doc pages are also served as raw .md files that agents can read directly. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on how to point an agent at these docs, and no independent community confirmation of agents using them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://help.getzep.com/llms.txt # Zep Documentation
